summary: First end-to-end test of WhisperVine (FastAPI + PostgreSQL + React + Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Gemini Nano Banana). 30 backend pytest cases (auth, vines, anonymous confessions w/ AI moderation, rate-limit, games w/ Claude-generated WYR question and anonymous voting, cards image serving, dashboard analytics) all PASSING. Frontend Playwright e2e: landing, login (creator@gmail.com/vinepass123), dashboard with stats + start-WYR/UO buttons, anonymous confession submit on /v/midnight-whispers-4b6bfc producing 'Whispered into the vine' toast and feed updating to 8 whispers, discover lists both vines, cards gallery serves the existing Gemini-generated novella image. Privacy invariant verified — POST /api/confessions/{slug} works without Authorization header.
critical_code_review_comments: confession_routes._rate_cache uses an in-process TTLCache — works for single-worker dev but will break under multi-worker / multi-pod deploys. Consider Redis-backed limiter before scaling.

fingerprint hashing uses raw IP+UA without a server-side secret salt; while the hash is opaque, adding a SECRET pepper in env would make rainbow-table style correlation impossible if the DB ever leaks fingerprints (game voter table).

card_routes.card_image filters '/' and '..' but not URL-encoded variants; FastAPI path param decodes %2F so it's protected today, just worth a comment / use Path validator. Tested encoded ../ traversal — server returns 404, safe.
auth.py does not appear to expire/blacklist JWTs on logout; the 7-day token lives until expiry. Acceptable for MVP, document as known limitation.
Game start endpoint synchronously waits for Claude (~3-8s); consider running in a background task with a 'pending' GameSession status so the dashboard click feels instant.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (landing, login, dashboard, vine feed + anonymous confession, discover, cards gallery)

seed_data_creation: Test runs created several `TEST_*@example.com` users + a few `TEST Vine xxxx` vines via API and 8 'rate test' confessions on the seeded vine while exercising rate-limit and benign-content classifier. None affect production data; vines/confessions remain in dev Postgres.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_whispervine_api.py covers all routers and uses creator@gmail.com / vinepass123 + seeded slug 'midnight-whispers-4b6bfc'. The test 'test_start_wyr_and_vote' actually starts a fresh Claude-backed Would-You-Rather session and ends it again; safe to re-run. Card generation (Gemini) is NOT exercised in tests to save credits — only image-serving of the existing 04b67c5d-88a1-4053-a6a3-3110cfabd8d5.jpg is verified. If retesting the dashboard 'Make Card' UI, expect 15-25s wait. Frontend confession submit button text is 'POST ANONYMOUSLY' (not 'Whisper'); login button text is 'ENTER'.
